div.div:
مُزَاوَلٌ pass. part. n. of 3: one says, مَا زَالَ هٰذَا الأَمْرُ مُزَاوَلًا بِأَيْدِيهِمْ (assumed tropical:) [This affair ceased not to be striven, or sought, to be accomplished by means of their hands]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also Frightened by a زَوْل, i. e. a form, or figure, appearing in the night. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
